notes.title: Led It Rain patch new mechanics 121224
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Gasoline Daredevils and Adrenaline Addicts[/b][/h1]

Key 121224 Update Features:

* December Update Launch
* 112 % more James Death.. James Death is dead, or is he?
* New player controller mechanisms (shift to boost this time for real, space to SLIIIIIDDDDEEEE).
* Cocktail minigame on victory lap.
* New score system after laps. The Awesome High Level score Board.
* Monsters now attack player bike. Full panic mode can be avoided by pressing F
* Monsters start to dance when near player cos they do not feel threatened.
* Graphical adjustments.. 0.03 % less bloom. 
* Additional Quality-of-Life Updates

* Coming soon on near death: Ultimate Evil BOSS Encounter 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25239449/5523a5069b6d07e5714d21729c3e91f95a236201.png[/img]

There is upcoming videos and advertisement because THE GAME feels really solid and good.

small update on upcoming changes for Led It Rain

WIP Led It Rain zombies near the unmoving bike do not attack but start to dance because James Death games protagonist is half zombie himself. This is something I wanted to add to the game long time. Also it is easier to make zombie encounter when they are close. There is new special attack when zombies get close while you are driving high speed and they feel threatened. Thank you Mixamo for excellent animations for zombie like funny dances. Of course this is homage to Michael Jackson and zombies who dance. Shamoon.

notes.title: Led It Rain Refueled
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25239449/cbe03b75762634f1d3d7ed7828573be1009c03f2.png[/img]

Led It Rain patch 1.4 Refueled

New version of game editor Unity 2019
- Game mechanics overhaul. 
- Shooting mechanics. Bullets and visual now exactly in same place. New visual bullet trail.
- Driving mechanics. It is easier to turn. Feels more like motorcycle.
- Graphical updates. Color correction and graphical adjustments and post process effects.
- End game. Boss encounter phase one. 
- Sound design. Mono sounds won´t break and adjusted levels of sounds.
- Story screen "Comics"
- Better loading time. No freezing on load.

- James Death skins. 6 different skins.
- Marialyn babe skins. 6 different skins.
- Marialyn functionality on levels.
- Big monsters won´t force you away from track.
- Ragdoll now takes animation state from monster.
- After race score. Scorenator everything now on one screen.
- Score adjustments. No more random.
- Haven level after race all levels accessible.

Please support development of Led It Rain by participating on commentary on Discord (https://discord.gg/kQUHewjaCg) and Steam forums and buying the game for yourself and your friends. And letting people know about Led It Rain - it has been Refueled

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25239449/0c10eab4f2c83906e10376acca72a3ece192d82e.png[/img]

Led It Rain is the PC desktop and VR game currently in Steam store. Led It Rain franchise is being developed  by Helsinki based solo indie developer Ataverti. Led It Rain Desktop (1.4 Refueled version) is being sold at reasonable price of 10 euros and VR (Early Access) version is free. Desktop version has 5 levels, shop, extras and endgame while VR currently has 3 levels.

Led It Rain is arcadish camp humor filled motorcycle racing extravaganza which incorporates shooting mechanics into the game! Feel like superhero badass biker saving monsters to afterlife from zombie apocalypse! Faster, faster, faster, until the thrill of speed overcomes the fear of death, James Death.
